title: Introductory French Studies I
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText:
All students need to take the online French Placement Test (contact Program Convenor or admin.HAL@anu.edu.au ).

Students are not able to enrol in this course if they have previously completed FREN1003 or any of the following FREN courses: FREN1004, FREN1102, FREN2024, FREN2101, FREN2025, FREN2102, FREN3006, FREN3101, FREN3007, FREN3102, FREN3010, FREN3103, FREN3011, FREN3104, FREN3107, FREN3108, FREN3012, FREN3109, FREN2021, FREN3021, FREN3110, FREN3515.

title: Introductory French Studies II
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed FREN1003 or FREN1101 or have equivalent level of language proficiency as demonstrated by placement test. Alternatively you may gain permission of the Course Convenor to enrol in this course.

Students are not able to enrol in this course if they have previously completed FREN1004 or any of the following FREN courses: FREN2024, FREN2101, FREN2025, FREN2102, FREN3006, FREN3101, FREN3007, FREN3102, FREN3010, FREN3103, FREN3011, FREN3104, FREN3107, FREN3108, FREN3012, FREN3109, FREN2021, FREN3021, FREN3110, FREN3515.

title: Continuing French Studies I
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText:

You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed any of the following FREN courses: FREN2024, FREN2025, FREN2102, FREN3006, FREN3101, FREN3007, FREN3102, FREN3010, FREN3103, FREN3011, FREN3104, FREN3107, FREN3108, FREN3012, FREN3109, FREN2021, FREN3021, FREN3110, FREN3515.

title: Intermediate French Studies II

title: Advanced French Studies I
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed FREN3102 or FREN3007, or have equivalent level of language proficiency as demonstrated by placement test, or with permission of the convener. You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed any of the following courses: FREN3009, FREN3010, FREN3011, FREN3104, FREN6010, FREN6011 or FREN6509.

title: Advanced French Studies II
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed FREN3008, FREN3010, or FREN3103, or have equivalent level of language proficiency as demonstrated by placement test, or with permission of the convener. You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed FREN3009, FREN3011, FREN6011 or FREN6509.

title: Voyages littéraires: Literature in French
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed FREN3102 or FREN3007 with a minimum mark of credit; or have completed Advanced French Studies I or II; or have obtained the permission of the convener. This course may be completed more than once if taken with a different topic each time.

title: From Colonialism to Cinéma-monde: Films of the French-speaking World
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed FREN3102 or FREN3007 with a minimum mark of credit; or have completed Advanced French Studies I or II; or have obtained the permission of the convener. This course may be completed more than once if taken with a different topic each time. You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed FREN6514, FILM2014, FILM6014, SCRN2108 with the same topic.

title: Global Paris: Culture, History and Identity in the French Capital
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed one of the following courses: FREN3102, FREN3007, FREN3103, FREN3010, FREN3104, FREN3011, or with permission of the convener. You will need to contact the School of Literature, Languages and Linguistics to request a permission code to enrol in this course. Students cannot enrol in FREN3109 if they have completed FREN3012.

title: Selected Topics in French Studies
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed FREN3102 or FREN3007 with a minimum mark of Credit; or have completed Advanced French Studies I or II; or have obtained the permission of the convener. This course may be completed more than once if taken on a different topic each time. As this is a topics based course, students who have completed FREN3110, FREN2021, FREN3021 or FREN6510, please contact the convener for further advice and a permission code.

title: The Sounds of French: Phonetics and Pronunciation
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: To enrol in this course, you must have completed FREN3101 or FREN3006, or have equivalent level of language proficiency as demonstrated by placement test, or with permission of the convener.
